title: Copilot Studio: PPAC Reporting API for daily usage data
summary: The roadmap facts and the documented reporting and spending controls are supported. Two minor corrections remain: acknowledge the newly documented preview usage-report tutorial and qualify the background authoring licence requirements. Microsoft does not explicitly identify the preview licensing operation as the API named in the roadmap.

claims.where: What's changing: Learn documentation; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Learn does not document an API explicitly under the roadmap name PPAC Reporting API.
claims.quote: Searched: "PPAC Reporting API" Copilot Studio default license permissions limits; "PPAC" "Reporting" "API" "Copilot". Read cited capacity, REST and CLI pages and the linked preview usage-report tutorial; none explicitly uses that roadmap name.
claims.fix: Replace the documentation-gap sentence with: 'Learn now documents programmatic Copilot Studio usage reporting in preview, including an end-to-end tutorial, but does not explicitly identify it as the PPAC Reporting API named in the roadmap.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/programmability-tutorial-download-copilot-credit-usage-reports. Retain the distinction between the documented preview operation and the roadmap description.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout

claims.quote: From the Summary tab, you can download reports that organize consumption by environment, agent, or user.

claims.claim: The documented licensing-report download returns a gzip-compressed CSV file.
claims.quote: (Preview) Downloads a generated licensing report as a gzip-compressed CSV file.

claims.where: What's changing; controls[0].note; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not explicitly identified the licensing-report operation as the roadmap API or its predecessor.
claims.quote: Searched: "PPAC" "Reporting" "API" "Copilot". Read the roadmap, capacity page, generate/download licensing-report references, CLI reference and linked usage-report tutorial; none explicitly connects the operation to roadmap 579968.

claims.claim: The admin-center report-download route requires an administrator to initiate the download manually.
claims.quote: Select Download report. ... Select the download type you need: environment, agent, or user. ... Download the report.

claims.quote: usage from sessions where the user didn't sign in ... can appear under the user ID 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 with no user name.

claims.quote: Searched: "PPAC Reporting API" Copilot Studio default license permissions limits. Read general API reference and usage-report tutorial: delegated-only authentication is documented for usage reports, without an explicit identification with the roadmap-named API.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model, summary; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: A licence entitlement specifically covering the roadmap-named reporting API is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: "PPAC Reporting API" Copilot Studio default license permissions limits; "Copilot" "usage reports" "API" "limits" "license". Read requirements-licensing, billing-licensing and usage-report tutorial. Authoring/client requirements do not state a licence for the named standalone reporting API.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The cited licensing page says creating and managing agents needs a Copilot Studio User License for each author.
claims.quote: To create and manage agents with Copilot Studio, you need: A license for each user ... Copilot Studio User License
claims.fix: Replace the background authoring-licence statement in licensing.notes and Cost and licensing with: 'For standard-harness agent authoring, the cited page lists a Copilot Studio User License per author and a tenant licence. The licensing overview also lists Copilot Studio authors access, a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence or a trial licence as access routes.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/billing-licensing. Keep the reporting API's own entitlement open.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The cited agent-authoring licensing page also lists an organizational tenant licence.
claims.quote: A license for your organization, also known as a tenant license (or Copilot Studio as referred to on the Microsoft 365 admin center).

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The cited authoring-licensing page does not mention reporting APIs.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot" "usage reports" "API" "limits" "license". Read https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/requirements-licensing in full; it covers author and tenant licensing, not entitlement to reporting APIs.

claims.claim: No charge or per-call price for the roadmap-named API was found.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Studio" "Reporting API" "price" "retire"; "Copilot" "usage reports" "API" "limits" "license". Read product billing/licensing pages, capacity page, REST references and usage-report tutorial; none publishes a price for calling the named API.

claims.claim: The admin center reports Copilot Credit consumption.
claims.quote: The Copilot Credit capacity tab ... shows a product-focused view of Copilot Studio credit units consumed.

claims.claim: One agent interaction can consume several Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: One interaction with an agent can consume several credits

claims.claim: Features used during an interaction have their own credit rates.
claims.quote: because each feature the agent uses in that interaction has its own rate.

claims.claim: Call limits specifically identified with the roadmap-named API are not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: "PPAC Reporting API" Copilot Studio default license permissions limits; site:learn.microsoft.com/power-platform "usage reports" "service protection". Read generate-report reference and tutorial: the latter discusses 429 responses, without identifying limits with the roadmap-named API.

claims.claim: Prerequisites specifically identified with the roadmap-named API are not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: "PPAC Reporting API" Copilot Studio default license permissions limits. Read roadmap and usage-report tutorial prerequisites. The tutorial documents usage-report clients and delegated administrator access, but does not explicitly identify them as prerequisites of the roadmap-named API.

claims.claim: The admin-center report documentation qualifies user-level consumption reporting to standard-harness agents.
claims.quote: For agents powered by the standard harness, the user report also shows consumption by user.

claims.claim: The PPAC report-download path is Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Download report.
claims.quote: select Licensing. ... under Products, select Copilot Studio. ... Select the Summary tab. ... Select Download report.

claims.claim: POST https://api.powerplatform.com/copilotstudio/licensing/reports/{ReportName}?api-version=2024-10-01 starts tenant licensing-report generation.
claims.quote: POST https://api.powerplatform.com/copilotstudio/licensing/reports/{ReportName}?api-version=2024-10-01

claims.claim: The report request body accepts startDate.
claims.quote: startDate | True | string (date) | The inclusive UTC start date of the report range.

claims.claim: The report request body accepts endDate.
claims.quote: endDate | True | string (date) | The inclusive UTC end date of the report range.

claims.claim: The report request body accepts granularity.
claims.quote: granularity | | CopilotStudioLicensingReportGranularity | The granularity of a licensing report.

claims.claim: PPAC exposes agent monthly-limit management at Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Manage Agents.
claims.quote: select Licensing. ... under Products, select Copilot Studio. ... On the Summary tab, select Manage Agents. ... You can set a monthly limit for any agent directly from this page.

claims.claim: Agent monthly limits are not applied instantly and an agent can continue responding after reaching its limit.
claims.quote: Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit

claims.claim: An agent's monthly limit does not stop agent flows it calls.
claims.quote: An agent's monthly limit doesn't stop the agent flows that the agent calls. Agent flows are billed and checked for capacity separately

claims.claim: A configurable hard stop turns off the agent when it reaches the monthly limit.
claims.quote: After you set limits, you can configure two key guardrails: ... Hard stop: The agent is automatically turned off once it hits the defined limit.

claims.where: Governance controls: new API on/off and caller restrictions
claims.claim: A dedicated control enabling, disabling or restricting callers of the roadmap-named API is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot" "reporting API" "enable"; "PPAC Reporting API" Copilot Studio default license permissions limits. Read capacity page, API authentication overview, report reference and tutorial; found role-based report prerequisites, not a separate switch for the roadmap-named API.
